In a cave beneath the {wiki:Greenclaw Swamp|Greenclaw Swamp} there is a coffin guarded by mummies. Go down the cave, kill three {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, open a hole with the pick and face up to five {creature:Mummy|Mummies} in a small room to get a {item:Silver Brooch}, 2 {item:Small Ruby|Small Rubies} and 3 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}.

There are several paths to this cave; this guide follows the safest one.
Lure the Bonelords one by one if you do not want to spend many resources.

Go to the cave entrance in the **Greenclaw Swamp**, the swamp between Kazordoon and Venore ({coord:32759,31989,7}). The fastest way is to come from the **west**, over the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge|Dwarf Bridge}, and walk **east**; you can also cross the swamp from the **northwest** exit of Venore. Bring the {item:Machete} to cut the jungle grass that blocks the swamp paths. You have to fall through a partially hidden pitfall.

Once in the cave, follow the path on the map **east** and go down the hole. You will meet {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} and, sometimes, a {creature:Bonelord} lured by other players.
Follow this short passage **south** (there are no monsters) and go down the hole.
Short passage south to the hole
Follow the path **east** and then **south**. In the larger room there are **3 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}**: kill them (you can lure them one by one).
Use the {item:Pick} on the area marked with a circle on the map and go down the hole.
Use the pick on the spot marked with the circle
Down there you are in a very small room with up to **5 {creature:Mummy|Mummies}**. Kill them all.
The mummies' room with the coffin to the north
Five mummies in a tight room hit hard: go in with full health and potions at hand.
Use the coffin on the **north** side of the room to receive the reward.

To leave, go back the same way to the first floor of the cave: use the {item:Rope} to climb up through the pick hole and the two holes you went down earlier, retracing the route on the maps in reverse. The pitfall you came in by only goes down, but the cave has several entrances: leave by the nearest way up back to the **Greenclaw Swamp** (bring the {item:Rope} and the {item:Shovel} from the equipment list). From there head **east** to Venore or **west** to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge|Dwarf Bridge}.
